findings.summary: frontend/ dir present but no package.json (static-assets dir) must SKIP, not FAIL.
findings.mitigation: Lane gate gate-on-present: existsSync('frontend/package.json') at top → SKIP+exit0 if absent.

findings.summary: Lane gate must NOT fire for frontend-spa archetype (root-level wiring already exists) — double-run/double-count risk.
findings.mitigation: Wire+emit guard keys on archetype!==undefined && archetype!=='frontend-spa' && lanes.includes('frontend'). Unit asserts NOT emitted for frontend-spa.

findings.summary: tsc/vitest in cwd:frontend ENOENT if subtree node_modules absent (local pre-commit without npm ci --prefix frontend).
findings.mitigation: Gate-on-present checks frontend/node_modules before running tools; SKIP with install hint (mirrors playwright-rules SKIP pattern). CI workflow runs npm ci --prefix frontend first.

findings.summary: ci-alignment gate (#240) scans ci.yml; lane gate runs in separate 18-frontend-lane.yml workflow. Could it flag manifest-only?
findings.mitigation: Not a regression: identical pattern to existing node-script gates (check-constraint-scan.mjs, check-collab-mode-wired.mjs) already shipped. Alignment treats node-script gates uniformly; my gate adds no new class. Self-repo (docs lane) never emits it, so self-alignment unaffected.
